text:
Maya (AE): Quick sync - EU medical customer needs SOC2 proofs + a signed pen-test letter before POC. They also flagged PHI residency and CMK requirement. Kickoff target: Tue.
Jon (SolutionsEng): Can we do a hosted EU POC that meets their needs? Short answer: hosted = eu region + encrypted at rest, but CMK (customer KMS) only on Dedicated/Private.
Maya (AE): They want cost delta & timeline (hosted vs dedicated). Also SSO Okta, retention 90 days.
Ravi (SRE): Timeline: hosted staging in eu-west provision -> 1-2 business days. Dedicated onboarding with peering + CMK -> 3-5 weeks. Networking windows may add delay.
Priya (Security): For attestation: we can issue a signed pen-test attestation summarizing our testing cadence, last test month/year, and remediation status. We can't hand over vendor reports. If customer demands a dedicated pentest naming them, that's an additional engagement and cost.
ComplianceBot: Attached: https://redwood.box.com/shared/soc2-aoc-current (SOC2 AOC), https://redwood.box.com/shared/pen-test-attest-template (Pen-test attestation)
Jon (SolutionsEng): Practical POC options (short):
- Option A: Hosted EU POC (fast) -> no CMK, standard TOS, provide SOC2 AOC and signed attestation; SAML test app + allowlist IPs.
- Option B: Dedicated (isolation + CMK + SLA) -> onboarding 3-5w, monthly commit, onboarding fee, legal SLA addendum possible.
Maya (AE): Can Legal sign the attestation quickly? They want it on company letterhead.
Priya (Security): Yes, we route to Legal for signature. ETA: same day if not heavy redlines.
Maya (AE): Pricing ballpark needed to present to customer now.
Ravi (SRE): Ballpark: Hosted POC run costs = usage-based (tokens/embeddings) + trivial infra. Dedicated entry-level commit ~ 3k-5k EUR/month depending on GPU mix + one-time onboarding ~ 8-12k EUR (network, peering, certs). These are estimates; I'll confirm exact quote with Pricing.
Jon (SolutionsEng): POC runbook I'll drop: SAML ACS URL: `https://poc.eu.redwood.ai/saml/acs`
Entity ID: `urn:redwood:poc:eu`
Test user format: `poc-test+<team>@example.com`
Also include sample allowlist IPs in the runbook.
Maya (AE): Customer also asked whether SOC2 scope explicitly references PHI handling.
Priya (Security): Good catch. Our SOC2 covers customer data processing for inference services, but I need Compliance to confirm if PHI is explicitly in scope. Filing ticket.
ComplianceBot: Ticket #CMP-4712 opened to verify SOC2 scope re: PHI.
Jon (SolutionsEng): If customer accepts Hosted for POC, we can proceed with staging creds and the attestation by EOD.
Maya (AE): Perfect. Can someone draft a concise email (one-pager) with the two options + timelines + attachments so I can send it?
Ravi (SRE): I'll prepare a short cost comparison and timeline summary and share in-thread.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the attestation text and loop Legal.
Jon (SolutionsEng): I'll attach the POC runbook and SAML sample.
Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll hold off on scheduling kickoff until customer confirms Hosted vs Dedicated.
Ravi (SRE): Note: if Dedicated chosen, block peering calendar next month and budget for cert provisioning (~3 days).
Priya (Security): Also warning: customer-requested CMK means we need KMS integration tickets + HSM review for EU region. That can add 1-2 weeks if custom key workflows required.
Maya (AE): Good to know. I'll relay that to the customer. Closing loop after docs land. :thumbsup:
